payload.description:
As a platform operator, I want command ownership to be stored durably with leases and fencing, so that duplicate deliveries and failed workers cannot produce conflicting results.

Feature: Durable command lifecycle ownership

Scenario: One worker obtains a command lease
Given an announced command envelope
When a worker claims the command
Then it receives a new fencing token and renewable lease

Scenario: A concurrent worker cannot execute an active command
Given a command with an unexpired lease
When another worker claims the same envelope
Then the claim is reported as active without a new fencing token

Scenario: A stale worker cannot settle a command
Given a replacement worker has claimed a newer fencing token
When the prior worker reports progress or completion
Then the store rejects that mutation

Scenario: A cancellation request is observed durably
Given a running claimed command
When cancellation is requested
Then the owner can settle it as cancelled
And no later success settlement is accepted.
payload.title: Durable command claims reject stale workers
